name: Moon Ahin's polished husk
source_design: CHARACTER_DESIGNS_v2.md sections 2.11 and 3; ASSETS_ARC2_BRIEF.md S19; README_START_HERE.md 27 October overrides
locks: 175 cm; elegant long-limbed adult mannequin proportions, approximately 7.5–8 heads, legs about half standing height.
Blank oval face without eyes, nose, mouth, ears, hair or other features.
Smooth simplified torso, abdomen, pelvis and rear; no navel, cleft, anatomical or muscle lines.
Porcelain white with restrained soft gloss; fine silver seams at shoulders, elbows, hips and knees. Each hip seam is a separate horizontal ring round the top of its thigh.
Simple five-finger hands and plain moulded feet with fused toes.
No clothes, weapons, brand marks, text, glow, machinery or cracks.
Neutral stiff stance in the front and turnaround; synchronized unarmed fencing lunge in the formation.
No 178 cm scale silhouette, per the 27 October override.
